articles.title: New KITAS Regulations Effective March 2026
articles.summary: Indonesia announces simplified KITAS renewal process starting March 2026, reducing processing time from 30 to 14 days for existing holders.
articles.text: The Indonesian Immigration Directorate has announced significant changes to the KITAS (Limited Stay Permit Card) renewal process. Starting March 1, 2026, existing KITAS holders will benefit from a streamlined renewal procedure that cuts processing time in half. The new system introduces online document submission and automated verification for straightforward cases. Immigration officials stated this change aims to improve service quality and reduce administrative burden on foreign residents.

articles.title: Tax Amnesty Program Extended to June 2026
articles.summary: Ministry of Finance extends voluntary tax amnesty program for foreign-owned PMA companies until June 30, 2026.
articles.text: The Indonesian Ministry of Finance has announced a three-month extension of the voluntary tax amnesty program specifically targeting foreign-owned PMA (Penanaman Modal Asing) companies. The program, originally set to end in March 2026, will now run until June 30, 2026. Companies participating in the amnesty can declare unreported assets with reduced penalties and interest rates. Tax officials encourage compliance before the deadline as enforcement actions will intensify after program closure.

articles.title: Digital Nomad Visa Requirements Clarified
articles.summary: Immigration authority publishes detailed requirements for new Digital Nomad visa category including minimum income thresholds.
articles.text: Following months of speculation, the Indonesian Immigration Directorate has released comprehensive guidelines for the new Digital Nomad Visa (B211A category). The visa requires applicants to demonstrate monthly income of at least USD 2,000 from foreign sources, health insurance coverage valid in Indonesia, and proof of accommodation. The visa allows stays of up to 5 years with multiple re-entry privileges. Applications can be submitted through Indonesian embassies worldwide starting April 2026.
